WITH total_hours AS (
    SELECT e.Ssn,
           e.Fname,
           e.Lname,
           e.Dno,
           COALESCE(SUM(w.Hours), 0) AS total_hours
    FROM employee e
    LEFT JOIN works_on w ON e.Ssn = w.Essn
    LEFT JOIN project p ON w.Pno = p.Pnumber
    -- No start‑date column is available, so all projects are considered
    GROUP BY e.Ssn, e.Fname, e.Lname, e.Dno
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Dno ORDER BY total_hours) AS perc_rank
    FROM total_hours
)
SELECT Ssn,
       Fname,

WITH employee_hours AS (
    SELECT 
        e.Ssn,
        e.Dno,
        e.Fname,
        e.Lname,
        SUM(w.Hours) AS total_hours
    FROM employee e
    JOIN works_on w ON e.Ssn = w.Essn
    GROUP BY e.Ssn, e.Dno, e.Fname, e.Lname
),
ranked_employees AS (
    SELECT 
        Fname,
        Lname,
        Dno,
        total_hours,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Dno ORDER BY total_hours DESC) AS rank_within_dept
    FROM employee_hours
)
SELECT 
    Fname,
    Lname,
    rank_within_dept
FROM ranked_employees;
